title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
FOMC outcome: held 3.50–3.75%, 3 dissenters (Hammack/Kashkari/Logan) voted to hike. 10-yr yield +6bp to 4.66%. Dow -1,100pts, S&P 500 -1.5%.
Meta Q2: revenue $60.8B (beat $60.3B est), EPS $6.18 vs $7.22 expected — big miss. Shares -4% AH.
Microsoft Q4 FY26: results expected imminently after close; FY27 capex guided $255–260B (vs $190B prior).
